originals.ko: 나는 예전에 내가 남겨지지 않도록 이야기하곤 했어
originals.why: Tense clash: past habitual o'n i'n arfer followed by future fel na fydda i'n. Natural Welsh would use fel na faswn i'n, and the English source has the same mismatch.
